maps.name: 4tdm_gasworks
blockers: Current importer requires Quake BSP29; Source VBSP geometry, brush collision, displacements and material/lightmap structures need a dedicated converter.
Source game logic needs explicit translation to supported native TF objectives; silently replacing it with two-flag CTF would change the maps.
Source base-game materials and model dependencies are not all embedded in the archive.
